target: xhm-desktop release Private Bytes < 10 MiB in winit-software mode

accepted_baseline.observation: All accepted samples breach the P2 threshold. The condition string omits XHM_DESKTOP_UI_SMOKE; the launch witness and fresh trace show that this fixture expands the main panel, loads 36 process rows, and spawns a ping child. Child processes are not included in desktop PID samples.

runs.condition: exact accepted launch reconstruction: release + winit-software + XHM_DESKTOP_UI_SMOKE=1 + dual SSE unavailable
runs.observation: Threshold breach reproduced. The fresh range is 2.69-3.05 MiB above the accepted range, so the accepted numeric band is launcher/state sensitive, but the pass/fail result is unchanged.
runs.contradicting_evidence: The exact numeric range did not match the historical baseline; no claim is made that UI_SMOKE is representative of ordinary collapsed production state.

runs.condition: normal release + winit-software + main/taskbar visible + settings/about constructed hidden + tray + dual SSE unavailable
runs.observation: Ordinary collapsed release state is lower than UI_SMOKE but still exceeds the threshold by 23.514 MiB on mean and would require a 70.16% reduction.
runs.contradicting_evidence: This run had no live service; R4 separately covers connected SSE.

runs.condition: normal release + XHM_DESKTOP_G4_SMOKE=1; settings and about visible in addition to main/taskbar
runs.observation: Making the already-constructed Settings/About windows visible adds 6.421 MiB versus the separate normal run.
runs.contradicting_evidence: Separate-launch comparison includes normal allocator/ASLR variance; R5 confirms a 6.269 MiB cumulative delta in one process.

runs.condition: normal release copied beside a debug-only endpoint config; health succeeds and two SSE streams remain connected to a local fixture
runs.observation: Connected dual SSE is 0.237 MiB below the disconnected/retrying normal mean. Transport activity is not the dominant 23.5 MiB gap; both variants retain the async runtime and clients.
runs.contradicting_evidence: This differential does not isolate Tokio runtime ownership because the runtime exists in both runs.

runs.condition: single normal process with sequential tray/window actions; 20 samples per stage at 250 ms
runs.observation: Normal mean 33.711 MiB; showing Settings adds 4.648 MiB; then showing About adds another 1.621 MiB (6.269 MiB cumulative). Hiding the floating window does not decommit its retained backing allocations. WM_CLOSE requests for auxiliary/taskbar windows did not make those Slint windows disappear and are not treated as component-removal evidence.
runs.contradicting_evidence: Tray close and late thread-count changes are confounded by lifecycle timing and are not assigned a component MiB value.

result.conclusion: The P2 release-memory failure is reproducible in ordinary and smoke states; it is not limited to the historical sample run.
